source: Synthetic test fixture. Achievement names and descriptions are made up for the test suite and do not come from any player's profile.

achievements.name: Vault Whisperer
achievements.description: Complete the Big Bank job in stealth without the alarm going off on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

achievements.name: Loud and Clear
achievements.description: In the Big Bank job, kill 60 enemies during a single assault wave on the Very Hard difficulty or above.

achievements.name: Beat the Clock
achievements.description: Complete the Big Bank job in under 12 minutes on the Hard difficulty or above.

achievements.name: Last Man Standing
achievements.description: Complete the Big Bank job on the Death Wish difficulty or above without any player going into custody.

achievements.name: Paper Trail
achievements.description: In the Big Bank job, find and secure the hidden ledger.

achievements.name: Skyhook Special
achievements.description: In the GO Bank job, secure all bags of cash with the skyhook.

achievements.name: Quiet Withdrawal
achievements.description: Complete the GO Bank job without being detected.

achievements.name: Wrong Number
achievements.description: In the GO Bank job, answer every pager without any guard being alerted.

achievements.name: Spark Plug
achievements.description: On day 1 of the Firestarter job, destroy all the weapons in the hangar.

achievements.name: Server Room
achievements.description: On day 2 of the Firestarter job, complete the heist in stealth.

achievements.name: Burn Notice
achievements.description: On day 3 of the Firestarter job, burn all the money using only the thermite.

achievements.name: Rat Race
achievements.description: On day 1 of the Rats job, cook 7 bags of meth.

achievements.name: Bus Stop
achievements.description: On day 3 of the Rats job, escape with all the money from the bus.

achievements.name: Jailbreak
achievements.description: Complete the Hoxton Breakout job on the Mayhem difficulty or above.

achievements.name: Crew Cut
achievements.description: Complete the Hoxton Breakout job with all four players wearing the same mask.

achievements.name: Sharpshooter
achievements.description: Kill 100 enemies using only the Platypus 70 sniper rifle.

achievements.name: Wall of Lead
achievements.description: Kill 500 enemies using any shotgun.

achievements.name: Dress Code
achievements.description: Equip the Clown mask with the Checkered pattern.

achievements.name: Window Shopping
achievements.description: Purchase every weapon in the Gage Chivalry Pack.

achievements.name: Collector
achievements.description: Find all the hidden tapes in the Nightclub job.

achievements.name: Last Call
achievements.description: In the Nightclub job, complete the heist without killing any civilians on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

achievements.name: No Skills Required
achievements.description: Complete any heist on the Death Sentence difficulty with the One Down mechanic active without using any skills.

achievements.name: Marathon
achievements.description: Complete any job within 5 minutes on the Normal difficulty or above.

achievements.name: Hoarder
achievements.description: Secure 200 bags of loot across any heists.

achievements.name: Halfway There
achievements.description: Reach the fiftieth rank of Infamy.

achievements.name: Legend
achievements.description: Reach the hundredth rank of Infamy.

achievements.name: Bomb Squad
achievements.description: In the Bomb: Dockyard job, find the meth lab and secure the bomb within 8 minutes of the escape arriving.

achievements.name: Harbour Master
achievements.description: Complete the Bomb: Dockyard job in stealth without using any ECM jammers.

achievements.name: Opening Night
achievements.description: Complete the Nightclub job on the Normal difficulty.

achievements.name: First Payday
achievements.description: Complete your first heist.
